candidateOccurrences.sourceText: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
